purpose: Independent same-physical-input finite-time wave transfer between planar cut-cell Neumann FV and pinned MFEM P2 tetrahedron systems
fixture: sloped 4x4m floor, roof z=4-y/4; rigid Neumann; volume=56m3
finite_transfer: rho*r^T phi_t and exact midpoint Q_T/P_T with exp(+i2πft) kernel
mfem_integrator: same implicit midpoint for exported mass and stiffness; actual force c²*b*q injected on each midpoint; NOT a posteriori impulse convolution
relative_metric: L2 complex difference normalized to fine-level transfer; zero amplitude not clipped; 40 and 80 Hz both retained
goal: Evaluate MFEM 1→2 and 2→3, FV 20→24/24→28/28→32, cross-solver finest comparison MFEM r3 vs FV n32. Do not claim formal physical convergence from 3 FEM levels or 2 bins.
observational_limit: same physical geometry, medium, source, sampling and finite observation window, but different spatial shape functions; reference r3 not continuum ground truth
